description: This file defines a React functional component named 'FlashcardGrid' that renders a grid of flashcards. It displays a placeholder message when no flashcards are provided and maps over an array of flashcard objects to render individual 'FlashcardCard' components, passing relevant props and handling click and edit events.

methods.name: FlashcardGrid({ flashcards = [], topics = [], onCardClick, onCardEdit })
methods.description: A React functional component that displays a grid of flashcards with optional handlers for clicking and editing individual cards.
